Autoimmune urticaria is speculative; the only raw connection is Hashimoto disease, while the acute post-vaccination onset and negative prior urticaria history support an acquired allergic reaction.
Mast cell activation disorder is a broad mechanistic label not directly anchored to the raw vignette and is less specific than vaccination-associated allergic reaction.
Describes urticaria accurately but does not account for the causal vaccination timeline or the coexisting angioedema.
